naslov: Doncic leads Los Angeles against Detroit after 40-point showing
tekst:
Los Angeles Lakers (7-2, first in the Western Conference) vs. Detroit Pistons (6-2, third in the Eastern Conference)
              Detroit; Sunday, 6 p.m. EST
              BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles visits the Detroit Pistons after Luka Doncic scored 40 points in the Lakers' 116-103 victory over the Sacramento Kings.
              Detroit finished 60-22 overall with a 32-9 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pistons gave up 109.6 points per game while committing 22.0 fouls last season.
              Los Angeles went 53-29 overall with a 25-16 record on the road last season. The Lakers gave up 114.6 points per game while committing 18.5 fouls last season.
              INJURIES: Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Isaiah Joe: day to day (hip).
              Lakers: None listed.
